title: Rikkukin the Defender
summary: Respond to Rikkukin's directional warnings and wait out his frozen-aura stages.
overview: Respond to Rikkukin's directional warnings and wait out his frozen-aura stages.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Move away from the announced attack side and conserve damage resources during Frozen Aura.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: His warning identifies a right-claw, left-claw, tail or frontal breath attack before the cast follows.
At 65% and 30%, Frozen Aura begins a 30-second health-lock window; trying to push past its lower threshold heals him back.
After the first frozen stage, periodic light-reflection warnings lead to a blind effect.
Thirty seconds out of combat resets the fight.
